@graph.description: Lion's mane (Hericium erinaceus) is an edible mushroom studied for cognition, mood, and nerve-growth-related mechanisms. Human evidence remains early and product-specific, so fruiting-body, mycelium, and isolated-compound findings should not be treated as interchangeable or as proof of disease prevention.
